explanation: The implementation uses WP_HTML_Processor::normalize() to convert both HTML fragments into a canonical form. The normalize() method handles implied closing tags, attribute quoting normalization, tag-name case normalization, character reference decoding, and duplicate attribute removal—all the transformations a browser would apply during parsing. If either input cannot be fully parsed/normalized (normalize() returns null), we return false. Otherwise, we compare the two normalized results for exact equality.
